verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes GmbH/UG formation materials, a foundation questionnaire and a starter kit, and runs a 'Venture Deals in Germany' webinar on differences from other jurisdictions. Its client work also covers seat relocation and German market entry. However, none of this is published guidance on choosing between entity types or jurisdictions. Missing for 10: comparative guidance on entity choice (GmbH vs UG vs others), any coverage of Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd or Indian Pvt Ltd, and a framework for choosing a jurisdiction by target market.
